name: admin-console
title: Admin Console
description: The platform operator's console under /admin, for platform admins only (404 for anyone else): an overview with the product's own panels first, then the last 24 hours and integration health; a searchable, paged user directory with a record panel; a workspace's support page (plan, credit, members, payments, executions, and reason-required grant-plan, add-credit and impersonate actions); revenue and costs with the billing settings, the payment ledger and the usage ledger; and operations with failed jobs, unsettled executions and the audit trail by name. Reads come from @intelligo-dev/admin; the sidebar is lib/admin-nav.ts and the product's slots are lib/admin-config.tsx. Its page title, panels, URL-state data list and property list are for a product's own console pages too. Requires app-shell, pricing and route-error.
